newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-Newcastle sign England defender Pearce.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-Newcastle sign England defender Pearce.

text.p: English premier league soccer club Newcastle United said on Friday they had signed England international defender Stuart Pearce from Nottingham Forest on a free transfer.
Newcastle said Pearce, 35, had signed a three-year contract.
Pearce made more than 500 appearances for Forest in a 12-year career with the club. He had a spell as caretaker manager last season but could not prevent Forest from slipping to relegation.
Capped more than 70 times by England, Pearce should help to tighten a Newcastle defence which has often leaked goals at an alarming rate.
Newcastle will play in the preliminary round of next season's European Cup after finish as runners-up in the premier league last season.
